segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: …This is the Eagle. The bottom half.

segments.speaker: eagle
segments.text: I held them while they slept their first night on the Moon.

segments.speaker: eagle
segments.text: When they climbed back into the top half and went home, I stayed. I was the launchpad. The landing gear. The footprints around me haven't moved in fifty-five years. They'll outlast every building on Earth.

segments.speaker: eagle
segments.text: The plaque says "We came in peace for all mankind." I'm still holding that too.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: …Yeah. I don't think I need to add anything.
